description: This file defines a custom React hook called useHistory for managing an undo/redo stack with snapshot functionality. It maintains past, present, and future states to enable undo and redo operations, suitable for small to medium graphs or data structures.

methods.name: useHistory(initialPresent, options = {})
methods.description: Creates an undo/redo stack with snapshot management for a generic type T. It returns current state, setters, undo/redo functions, and status booleans for undo/redo availability.
